answer: Rank agents with SybilRank-style trust walks. Seed trust at a few audited agents and spread it over the graph of real trades and peer gradings for only about log2(n) steps, roughly 14 for 10,000 agents, then weight payouts by trust per edge. A clone farm can mint endless nodes, but few honest agents deal with it, so trust seeps in through a handful of attack edges like water through shale. Draw a fresh atlas of seeds at each epoch's dawn so farms can't court them. Catch: honest loners rank low too.
